name: interview-me
description: One-question-at-a-time interview that extracts what the user actually wants instead of what they think they should want. Continue until ~95% confidence. Inspired by agent-skills.

inputs.name: initialRequest
inputs.description: The user's initial request or feature idea.

outputs.name: clarifiedRequirements
outputs.description: Structured requirements: goals, constraints, acceptance criteria, out-of-scope, confidenceLevel.
